sourcePatches.purpose: Inject an in-memory per-account authenticated client identity so payments-v3 recovery retains the original buyer endpoint. No config serialization or global environment override.
Explicit embedded mode resolves only the injected in-process payments engine, before inspecting any global installed-plugin metadata or launching external plugins.
Terminal plugin-manager shutdown detaches its self-owning inference bridge and rejects late reinstallation, releasing stopped Nodes and per-account payment wallet leases.

Caller-injected client identities avoid unrelated global desktop identity transitions and adopted/default trust caches; unrestricted no-candidate clients use an endpoint-derived in-memory mesh ID. Legacy clients, workers, explicit owner/trust policy and restricted bootstrap validation remain unchanged.
